sections.Profile:
The "Dew-Wa-Ditty" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in June 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Good Times, Singing, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Music
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Design: Harry Williams
